body:
## Summary
- keep the Internet profile import dialog retryable by clearing stale inline errors as soon as the user edits a rejected draft
- require an explicit instrumentation opt-in for the Android-local MainActivity Internet UI/bootstrap acceptance path and make the Phase 3 runner pass that opt-in
- archive the 2026-09-16 Nubia P0110 no-Host profile import/bootstrap evidence and update Phase 3 docs to distinguish Android-local evidence from remaining production Authority, handoff, public Internet, media, and soak gates

## Pre-merge review
- traex/gpt-5.5 read-only reviewer reported no P0/P1/P2 blockers
- reviewer residual risk: did not run device tests or full Gradle suite; evidence boundaries remain Android-local/no-Host only

## Verification
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest tests.phase3.test_android_product_session_interop_acceptance -v` - 27/27 passed
- `./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.RealQrPairingStaticContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityTerminalGuidanceContractTest :app:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin` - BUILD SUCCESSFUL
- `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` from `docs/changes/2026-08-22-android-ui-ux-audit/evidence/2026-09-16-nubia-p0110-internet-profile-import-bootstrap` - all retained artifacts OK
- retained device evidence: Nubia P0110 / pacific / Android 16 opt-out instrumentation skipped without the opt-in marker; opt-in run passed 1/1 and emitted `PHASE3_ANDROID_INTERNET_UI_PASS internet_tab=true route_toggle=true pairing=true strict_lease_import=true retryable_import_error=true local_revoke=true repair=true secure_dialogs=true`

## Evidence boundary
No macOS Host was launched. No TCC, codesign, Keychain, Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, adb reverse tcp:54321, or local tcp:54321 listener was used. This closes only the Android-local MainActivity profile import/bootstrap evidence slice, not production Authority issuance, device handoff, public-network E2E, WebRTC transport, real QR decode, media decode/audio, latency, or soak gates.
title: test(android): refresh internet profile import evidence
